newsitem.title: USA: NYPA may eye another partner after Entergy talks.
newsitem.headline: NYPA may eye another partner after Entergy talks.

text.p: The New York Power Authority (NYPA) said it would still consider another utility partner to manage its two nuclear power stations after its negotiations with Entergy Corp ended Monday.
"It's possible we'll reach out to another utility," said NYPA spokesman Stephen Shoenholtz, but declined to identify the prospective candidates.
NYPA owns and operates the 800 megawatt (MW) Fitzpatrick plant in the town of Scriba, N.Y., and 965 MW Indian Point 3 nuclear unit in Buchanan.
